With that done, assure that the hatch is wide open. And then, make an attempt to go to the south. With that over with, open the gateway inside the restroom. If you have opened the gateway, make an effort to go to the east. And then, venture south. After that, go east. And then, assure that the door within the dish-pit is ajar. Then, make an effort to venture south. Then, lift the passkey from the floor of the sauna. Alright, thanks!
description:
